title: RPC: ConnectRPC services, SandboxBackend adapter, event streaming
description:
Implement RPC layer from docs/plans/13-rpc-layer.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (proto definitions), §4 (SandboxService — session CRUD, tool dispatch, snapshots), §4.2 (AgentEventService — event streaming), §5 (SandboxBackend adapter — client side), §6 (error model), §7 (retry policy)

Key deliverables:
- Proto definitions: SandboxService (CreateSession, DestroySession, PauseSession, ResumeSession, ExecuteTool, ExecuteToolStream, TurnComplete, CreateSnapshot, RollbackSession, ListSnapshots), AgentEventService (StreamAgentEvents)
- ConnectRPC server: SandboxService handler wrapping SandboxHostService, AgentEventService handler
- ExecuteToolStream: server-streaming RPC for Tier 2 tools — progress chunks + final response
- SandboxBackend: implements ToolBackend interface, translates tool calls to RPC, propagates onProgress via stream
- SnapshotID propagation: SandboxHostService → RPC stream → SandboxBackend → ToolResponse.SnapshotID
- Error model: map internal errors to Connect error codes, include structured error details
- Retry policy: idempotent ops retryable, non-idempotent not retryable, backoff config
- AgentEventSender/AgentEventReceiver: unidirectional stream (agent produces, controller consumes)
- Unit tests for all RPC handlers, SandboxBackend, error mapping, retry logic

See Implementation Guide §1.6: ToolBackend contract, SnapshotID propagation chain.
See Implementation Guide §1.8: AgentEventStream is unidirectional — do NOT return producer type to consumer code (P1 finding).

Depends on: Sandbox Host Service core (aiag-zvy.1) — RPC server wraps SandboxHostService.
